## Forms · Create Equipment Request → `n8n_createEquipmentRequest(actor, data, options)`
Real `submitEquipmentRequest` → `EQUIP_REQ_…` workflow written to *Initial Requests* (no internalEmployeeId, no `result` event). Next step: IT Confirmation → IT Setup → specialists.
**Required** (r2, verified): `firstName lastName siteName(reference.sites) managerEmail managerName position`
**Optional exposed:** `reqName reqEmail systems[] equipment[] department comments`; everything else from the new_hire-style optional list via `extra` (googleEmail/googleDomain, computer*, phone*, creditCard*, boss*, jonasJobNumbers, adpSites, purchasingSites, …). Handler forces `systemAccess='Yes'`. String values may not start with `= + - @`.
Returns `{ workflowId, scriptUrl }`. `includeRecord` → `record`. **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
